goal: Turn the previously observed but sub-gate residual-reversal tendency into a capital-compatible cross-sectional rank strategy without tuning the old z-score event definition.

RANK_REVERSAL_24H.residual: asset 24h return minus cross-sectional median 24h return

RANK_REVERSAL_48H.residual: asset 48h return minus cross-sectional median 48h return

RANK_REVERSAL_VOLUME.residual: asset 24h return minus cross-sectional median 24h return
RANK_REVERSAL_VOLUME.select: bottom 3 residuals, residual<=-4%, current candle closes in upper half, log-volume z>=1 over prior 42 bars

riskNote: base stop 2.75% implies 0.1925 USDT price risk on a 7 USDT order, below the 0.20 USDT cap before fees/slippage
drawdownMeasurement: sequential fixed-7-USDT trade PnL against 20.12-USDT starting equity during discovery; exact 2-position overlap simulated after holdout pass
